slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: “叮！检测到宿主年满十八，多子多福系统正式激活！”
“叮！检测到宿主拥有万古唯一‘天生生育圣体’，与系统完美契合，发放新手大礼包一份！”
江渊躺在自己那张由万年温玉打造的床上，享受着侍女小翠的膝枕和偶尔的洗面奶时，脑海里突然响起一连串响起的声音，吓得他还以为心魔来了。
可转念一想，他一个凡人哪来的心魔啊。
“系统？来的这么突然？”
没错，他是个穿越者，
十八年前正在纵情犬马的公子哥的他，眼睛一闭一睁就穿越到这个玄幻世界。
好消息投胎成了爹是大帝，娘是准帝，他们唯一的子嗣，背景逆天的江家帝子。
坏消息是，他似乎把所有的运气都用在投胎上，
完美地避开了大帝爹，准帝母遗传给他的所有天赋，是个修炼十八年连一境都踏不进的修炼废柴。
不过即便只是凡人，以江家的底蕴，让他活个几千上万年还是不成问题。
然而，好不容易穿越到玄幻世界，不能君临诸天万界实在是一件十分遗憾的事啊！
江渊拍拍手让小翠先离开，小翠会意点头然后开始脱衣裳，但被拍了两下屁股后知道少主这不是情趣的话后，听话地扭着翘臀离开。
“天生生育圣体？这他妈是什么鬼圣体？万界道体录里有这玩意儿？”
等小翠离开后，江渊心里忍不住嘀咕着。
【万界道体录】是诸天万界记录过所有出现过的特殊体质的名录，
他很确定这天生生育圣体绝对没在上面出现过，
因为这十八年来，江家把下至灵体，上至圣体，所有能激活特殊体质的办法都确认过了，确认他是真没特殊体质，也就是说是个比普通人还要惨的凡体凡人。
【天生生育圣体】：万古唯一特殊圣体，不具备任何战斗能力，唯一作用是能极大提升与异性诞下后代的几率，并且能优化后代基因，大概率诞生天资卓越的子嗣。
“这不成了移动的种马了？”
江渊的脸一下子就黑了。
别人体质都是增加战斗力，你这体质倒好增加怀孕率是吧！
“统子啊，你来晚十八年就给我这破能力？”
【本系统的目标只有一个，帮助宿主，繁育诸天！繁衍越多！反馈奖励越强！】
【当宿主与拥有特殊体质的女修诞下后代，后代数量与质量越强，宿主将会获得天赋、体质丹、圣器、极道帝兵、仙器、仙法等奖励！】
“统子啊，不是我看不起你，哦不，我就是看不起你，我江家乃大帝世家，你说的这些我江家都有。”
江渊他爹就是当世大帝，怎么会在乎区区一件极道帝兵。
【叮！是否打开新手大礼包？】
“开吧开吧。”
他倒要看看这什么多子多福系统能给出些什么玩意。
【恭喜宿主获得，升灵丹一枚：可将体质提升一个位格！（圣体之下有效）
体质增幅丹十枚：可临时增强宿主一倍体质，持续十二个时辰！】
直接提升一个大位格？
对圣体以下有效？
那岂不是说能让下品体质的修士瞬间拥有帝品资质？
江渊有些惊讶，他老爹便是以万道欲皇圣体证道成帝，他一般叫他欲皇大帝，不过外界更喜欢称呼为恒欲大帝。
而圣体体质便是帝品资质。
再大胆点想，一颗升灵丹就能多出一位有望准帝的天骄？
如果是真的……那这多子多福系统有点东西啊。
【新手任务发布：作为当世帝族帝子，与评分90分以上的天之骄女构建连接，使其怀孕诞下后代！】
“不是，你这评分又是什么鬼，我去哪里找什么天之娇女啊。”
虽然系统所谓的天之骄女可以是各大圣地的圣女，魔女之类的。
但他总不能直接去把人撸过来吧。
硬来的话……强抢圣女，等于向一个不朽势力宣战，他爹妈虽然是大帝，也架不住这么折腾啊。
content_en:
"Ding! It is detected that the host is over 18 years old, and the system of many children and many blessings is officially activated!"
"Ding! It has been detected that the host possesses the only 'natural fertility body' in eternity, which perfectly matches the system. A gift package for newbies will be issued!"
While Jiang Yuan was lying on his bed made of ten thousand years of warm jade, enjoying the knee pillow of the maid Xiaocui and the occasional facial cleanser, a series of sounds suddenly sounded in his mind, which scared him so much that he thought his inner demon was coming.
But then I thought about it, how could he, a mortal, have such inner demons?
"System? Did it come so suddenly?"
Yes, he is a time traveler,
Eighteen years ago, he was indulging in the young master's love, and he was transported into this fantasy world as soon as he closed and opened his eyes.
The good news is that he was reincarnated as his father is the great emperor, his mother is the quasi-emperor, their only heir, the son of the Jiang family with an unnatural background.
The bad news is that he seems to have spent all his luck on reincarnation.
He perfectly avoided the great emperor father and all the talents inherited from his quasi-emperor mother, but he was a training loser who couldn't even enter a realm after eighteen years of cultivation.
But even if he is just a mortal, with the Jiang family's background, it is not a problem for him to live for thousands of years.
However, after finally traveling to the fantasy world, it is really a pity not to be able to dominate the world!
Jiang Yuan clapped his hands and asked Xiao Cui to leave first. Xiao Cui nodded knowingly and started to take off her clothes. However, after being slapped twice on the buttocks and realizing that the young master was not talking about sex, she obediently twisted her buttocks and left.
"The Holy Body of Innate Fertility? What the hell kind of Holy Body is this? Is this thing in the Book of All Realms' Taoist Body?"
After Xiaocui left, Jiang Yuan couldn't help but murmur in his heart.
[All Worlds Dao Physique Record] is a directory that records all the special physiques that have appeared in all the worlds.
He was very sure that this holy body of fertility had never appeared on it before.
Because in the past eighteen years, the Jiang family has confirmed all methods that can activate special physiques, from spiritual bodies to holy bodies, and confirmed that he really has no special physique, which means that he is a mortal who is worse than ordinary people.
[Natural Fertility Sacred Body]: The only special holy body in eternity. It does not have any combat ability. Its only function is to greatly increase the probability of having offspring with the opposite sex, and it can optimize the genes of offspring, giving birth to children with excellent talents with a high probability.
"Isn't this a moving stallion?"
Jiang Yuan's face suddenly turned dark.
Other people's physiques only increase combat effectiveness, but your physique can increase your pregnancy rate, right?
"Tongzi, you came here eighteen years too late and you gave me this useless ability?"
[This system has only one goal, to help the host and breed the heavens! Reproduce more and more! The stronger the feedback reward! 】
[When the host and a female cultivator with a special physique give birth to offspring, the greater the quantity and quality of the offspring, the host will receive rewards such as talents, constitution pills, holy weapons, supreme emperor weapons, fairy weapons, fairy spells, etc.! 】
"Tongzi, it's not that I look down on you, oh no, I just look down on you. My Jiang family is a family of great emperors. I have all the things you mentioned."
Jiang Yuan's father is the current emperor, how could he care about a mere Ji Dao Imperial Weapon.
【bite! Do you want to open the newbie gift package? 】
"Let's go, let's go."
He wanted to see what this system of having many children and many blessings could offer.
[Congratulations to the host for getting a spiritual elixir: it can improve your physique by one level! (valid under the Eucharist)
Ten physical enhancement pills: can temporarily double the host's physical strength for twelve hours! 】
Directly promote a big position?
Effective for the Eucharist and below?
Doesn't that mean that a monk with a low-grade physique can instantly possess imperial-grade qualifications?
Jiang Yuan was a little surprised. His father used the Holy Body of the Wandao Yuhuang to achieve enlightenment and become an emperor. He usually called him Emperor Yuhuang, but the outside world preferred to call him Emperor Constant Yu.
And the Holy Body constitution is the imperial qualification.
If you think about it more boldly, a spiritual elixir can create one more genius who is expected to be a quasi-emperor?
If it is true...then there is something to this system of having many children and many blessings.
[Newbie mission released: As the son of the current emperor, establish a connection with the proud daughter of heaven with a score of 90 or above, so that she can become pregnant and give birth to offspring! 】
"No, what the hell is this rating of yours? Where am I going to find this beautiful girl from heaven?"
Although the system's so-called proud women of heaven can be saints, witches and the like from major holy places.
But he can't just go and pick people up.
If it comes to force... robbing the Saint is tantamount to declaring war on an immortal force. Even though his parents are great emperors, they can't stand such a torment.
